metadata.title: Automated Scoring of Constructed-Response Items Using Artificial Neural Networks in International Large-scale Assessment

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use ILSA achievement data as an outcome or predictor, focusing instead on automated scoring of constructed-response items.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses a holdout validation approach and does not mention any multilevel modeling or consideration of school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation using a simple holdout validation method, indicating no validation on external datasets.
